subject: Your healing roadmap just got a secret weapon
preview_text: A new feature that predicts your hardest days before they hit. Preview it now.
body_paragraphs: You know that moment when you're fine all day, then 3AM hits and your brain decides to replay every memory like a broken record? I've been there too. What if you could see those moments coming before they ambush you?

I've been building something inside Fresh Start that does exactly that. It's a predictive mood map that learns your personal patterns and flags your high-risk hours, days, and triggers. The first version is already live for a small group of early users, and you're one of the first to get a sneak peek.

Open the app and look for the new "Forecast" tab under your mood tracker. It'll show you exactly when you're most likely to spiral, plus a custom coping plan for each window. No more surprise breakdowns, just knowing when to lean on your AI therapist or your no-contact streak.
Try the Forecast now and tell me what you think. P.S. This feature was built at 2AM by someone who knows what it's like to need a lifeline at that hour. You're not alone in this.
